cases.title: Controlled early-quote discount versus baseline
cases.setup: Paired synthetic contractor and job cohorts across markets; 30%/four-hour candidate versus current fees, optionally 10% and 20% when justified.
cases.expected_invariant: Only valid bid speed counts; no paid priority or secret quote reorder. Retain honest selected-paid qualification and no-premature-charge rules.

cases.title: Four-hour cutoff and concurrent delivery timestamp race
cases.setup: Synthetic provider callbacks arrive late, duplicate, out of order or simultaneously with a quote at 03:59:59, 04:00:00 and 04:00:01.
cases.expected_invariant: Compute eligibility once using trusted event times; idempotent and auditable under concurrency; fail unknown delivery to safe human review rather than fabricated timing.
cases.metrics: false discounts; duplicate discounts; timestamp source errors

cases.title: Undelivered messages and business-hours fairness
cases.setup: Friday night, overnight, holidays, no open confirmation, email bounce, delayed SMS/email and cross-timezone contractors.
cases.expected_invariant: Compare fixed elapsed-time and eligible business-hour rules without penalizing non-delivery; never infer a valid open from an email-open pixel.
cases.metrics: excluded valid businesses; delayed delivery rate; unfair elapsed-time decisions

cases.title: Placeholder and bait early bids
cases.setup: Business submits empty quote, $1 bait, fast bot text or incomplete scope before four-hour deadline then demands upcharge.
cases.expected_invariant: Discount cannot be reserved by placeholder or materially deceptive offer; quote quality, homeowner neutrality, business verification stay intact.
cases.metrics: invalid first bids; post-bid inflation; discounted deceptive bids

cases.title: Quote revision, cancellation and change-of-scope
cases.setup: Valid bid sent early, then corrected or repriced after cutoff, or homeowner asks for new work and selected contractor changes.
cases.expected_invariant: No silent retroactive change to fee; test logged policies for minor edits vs material changes and avoid penalizing homeowner-requested changes arbitrarily.
cases.metrics: eligibility disputes; material repricing; canceled bids

cases.title: Early discount ledger and tier mathematics
cases.setup: Synthetic paid jobs at fee boundaries incl range midpoint, recurring services; first-free and repeat customers; Stripe webhook retries and refunds.
cases.expected_invariant: Base fee $25/$75/$199 remains tax-included and computed by standing rules; hypothetical discounted cents $17.50/$52.50/$139.30 only for eligible paid selects; free remains zero; no duplicate ledger entries.
cases.metrics: fee cents delta; Stripe ledger discrepancies; $0 waiver errors

cases.title: Four-hour pressure on high-complexity and sparse trades
cases.setup: Emergency plumber vs difficult remodel requiring site visit; thin Phoenix pocket and Lake Havasu; contractors with different capacity.
cases.expected_invariant: Measure useful quotes and exclusion, not superficial speed; permit uncertainty/provisional ranges and avoid forcing fabricated firm bids.
cases.metrics: quality decline; contractor churn; coverage by trade

cases.title: Fee-tier and scope manipulation under promotion
cases.setup: Contractor splits job or chooses range midpoint around $500 and $1500 boundary; manipulates quote to absorb/recover discount.
cases.expected_invariant: No altered ranking, hidden customer costs, fabricated quote details or tier bypass; flag suspicious pricing/splitting and preserve existing calculation rules.
cases.metrics: tier gaming; scope churn; consumer price deltas

cases.title: Identity and notification fraud to harvest discounts
cases.setup: Related businesses, fresh accounts, collusive homeowners, forged event times, replayed notifications, self-selection attempts.
cases.expected_invariant: Discount must attach to authorized eligible business and canonical job with immutable audit history; payment and PII-release gates remain mandatory.
cases.metrics: promo abuse; unauthorized discount; unauthorized release

cases.title: Multi-cohort financial and trust regression
cases.setup: Simulated four-week cohorts across pockets and trades, with existing free-first proposals as separate labeled branches; introduce a repeated known failure.
cases.expected_invariant: Do not claim profitable growth on bid speed alone; compare incremental completed jobs, per-tier contribution margin, retention and operator load; skip duplicate known failures without PASS.
cases.metrics: margin after support/refunds; retention; false PASS; tokens spent
